answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring stake-backed identities: every new identity locks collateral that is slashed when fraud is proven, so a fake-identity ripple of sockpuppet accounts faces real economic cost instead of free creation. New accounts then pass through a slow onboarding jetty, a probation window where established agents attest their behavior, while a public willow of visible reputation and attestation graphs lets anyone audit who vouches for whom.
